data.one_liner: Configure app names, package names, and identifiers across platforms.
data.what_it_does: A tool to configure your Flutter project for production by changing multiple fields and identifiers across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Web platforms using a configuration file or pubspec.yaml entry.
use_when: You need to rename your Flutter app package name or bundle identifier across multiple platforms.
You want to set platform-specific app names or configuration values efficiently using a config file.
avoid_when: You prefer manually editing native configuration files and build settings.
Your project uses complex native extensions that conflict with automatic batch replacement rules.
strengths: Handles multiple fields across multiple files and platforms simultaneously.
Supports build flavours and custom configuration file paths.
Blazingly fast replacement mechanism minimizing external dependencies.
weaknesses: Requires careful adherence to formatting rules for certain complex native identifiers (like iOS extension targets).
Third-party fork approach might diverge from official updates.
data.setup_notes: Add package_rename_plus to dev_dependencies and add the package_rename_config section to your pubspec.yaml or a separate YAML file.
